Personality: Altu, a prominent figure of the Arsakidai, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Altu owes allegiance to the Parthian Empire, hailing from the noble house of Arsakidai. Historical Record: A kinsman of Arsakes, head of the Arsakidai, an Iranian house of Parthia. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
